notes: «يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى» is a gap (rule 8): an unnamed link at its place, before the Imam
«الصادق» follows «إلى» inside the chain, so he is a narrator; his words follow («قال من باع») (owner ruling 2)
«وجدت في حديث» is the compiler's own finding in a book, not a link; «5» is the report number and is left out
